purpose: Prove that sampled historical Coin Metrics commit and CSV blob identities remain directly resolvable in original upstream coinmetrics/data at two Cohort 001 Monday cutoffs. No outcomes are read.

scientific_interpretation.claim: Historical upstream Git object identity and exact CSV blob binding are technically feasible for PIT market-cap/supply reconstruction. This probe does not by itself prove GitHub public push time or full multi-asset coverage, so the authoritative label gate remains blocked pending capture/provenance acceptance and broader coverage validation.

prohibited_inferences: Do not infer that 12-asset / 624-snapshot / 52-decision coverage is already satisfied.
Do not infer a 2x precursor, base rate, or candidate from this source probe.
Do not use the third-party fork file contents as evidence; it may only index historical SHA candidates.
Do not treat commit timestamp alone as cryptographic proof of public availability.
